title: Correct displacement expression
description: Essential: The response must give the correct function y = 5 cos((5π/3)t) cm, or equivalent with correct amplitude, angular frequency, and cosine form.

title: Correct total distance
description: Essential: The final answer for the total distance traveled in 0–12.9 s must be 2.15 m (or 215 cm).

title: Correct acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for the acceleration magnitude at the highest point must be 5 m/s².

title: Uses graph for amplitude/period
description: Important: The solution correctly extracts the amplitude (5 cm) and period (1.2 s) from the provided figure.

title: Applies SHM distance formula
description: Important: The calculation for total distance correctly uses the relationship s = 4A * (t/T) for the number of oscillations.

title: Applies Newton's second law at highest point
description: Important: For part (3), the solution correctly sets up ma = mg - kx using the given elongation to find acceleration.

title: Determines spring constant
description: Optional: The solution shows the step of finding the spring constant k = mg/x' from the static equilibrium condition.

title: Unit consistency/conversion
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use or conversion of units (e.g., cm to m).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the sign of acceleration (direction) is confused, or if the net force equation uses incorrect signs (e.g., ma = kx - mg).

title: Misinterprets number of oscillations
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the distance calculation incorrectly handles the fractional oscillation (e.g., rounds 10.75 to 10 or 11 without proper reasoning).
